title: fix: install official plugins from the chat card without leaving the conversation
body:
## What Problem This Solves

When the agent recommends a plugin in chat, the card shows an **Install** button. Selecting it did not install anything: it opened the plugin page, where you had to find and select **Install** a second time, and you lost your place in the conversation.

## User Impact

User impact: selecting **Install** on an official plugin card now installs the plugin right there. The card shows **Installing**, then **Installed** (or **Connect** when the plugin needs an account), and the chat stays open.

Unchanged on purpose:

- Community plugin cards and skill cards still open their details, as the chat docs describe. A community package is installed from its plugin overview.
- A configured install-policy warning still needs an explicit acknowledgment. When an official plugin has one, the card opens the plugin overview, which is where that review is presented.

## Why This Change Was Made

The card's button was wired to navigate to the plugin page with an install hint that the page deliberately ignores, so the click could never start an install. The card now sends the install itself, through the same install owner and config write queue the plugin page uses, so progress, failures and retries look the same in both places and an install started in chat is visible on the plugin page too.

A second click before the first request is admitted does not queue a second install. A retryable failure retries from the card. Anything the card cannot present (a policy review, or a config write refused before a request was sent, for example during an update) opens the plugin page instead of failing silently. Warnings returned with a successful install, which the plugin page lists beside the plugin's row, are announced in a toast because a card has no row to hold them.

## Evidence

Scenario: an official plugin card in chat, **Install** selected once. Before is `main` at `ff4a6c70d6b`; after is this branch. Both run the real Control UI production bundle in Chromium at 1280×720 against the repository's mocked Gateway fixtures (synthetic plugin data, no real installation).

### Clean comparison

Before: the click leaves the chat and no install request is sent.

![Before: selecting Install opened the plugin page instead of installing](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/23f16333-d978-4273-80e1-e85cdd671b95)

After: the same click starts the install in the conversation.

![After: the card shows Installing and the chat stays open](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0ae9d743-adec-4bc1-826f-f5e5f1626fea)

After the Gateway confirms the install:

![After: the card shows Installed with a Manage action, still in chat](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4a834ee4-9699-45ae-bf74-8e8d20d65f16)

### Annotated comparison

![Before, annotated: the plugin page with its own Install button highlighted](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6b84c553-8aea-41d1-998c-b48c5f0669be)

![After, annotated: the chat card in its Installing state highlighted](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8819f428-731c-4b51-8cd0-125d4f182b8c)

Recordings of the same click, before then after:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/83f2e12e-81fd-4f6f-8adc-91d5da1774ee

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd864fc9-b064-4ba8-a2ee-d4733ac2be7b

Checks on this head:

- New unit test fails on `main` (the card never installs) and passes here. It also covers the double click, the warning announcement and the policy-warning handoff to the plugin page.
- The card's browser E2E suite passes (4 scenarios), including the new assertion that the official card sends one `plugins.install` request for the catalog package and never leaves the chat, and the existing community-card flow through the plugin page.
- `pnpm check:changed` passes (types, lint, line caps, i18n catalog, controller guard).

Not covered: a real Gateway installing a real package from ClawHub. The install request, progress events and result handling are the plugin page's existing path, exercised here against fixtures only.
